batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c JP Faulkner b PV Tambe

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b CH Morris

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c CH Morris b Ankit Sharma

balls.text: he misses yet another one! A full toss outside off
throws his bat at this back of the length delivery but still no timing, just a single to deep midwicket
full and wide outside off, Dhoni lets it go but this is well inside the marker
another quick delivery! This is back of length and Bravo looks to pull it to the leg side, but inside edges it on to his thigh pad.. picks up a single though
full and fast! Bravo was making room but doesn't make any connection, that flew past the off stump
how did he squeeze that out! Full on the leg stump and Bravo steers it through short third man for a boundary
another dot ball to Dhoni, who misses a full delivery outside off

this could have been another one of those tandem catches at the boundary, but that didn't work out well. Bravo hit that high but not long, and the long-on fielder got under it, but pushed it back towards long off, Steven Smith.. but it was not well-directed, goes over the other fielder. Don't think there was a need for that, as Karun could have completed the catch himself.. he had enough space
slower delivery on the stumps, Dhoni looks for the big hit but doesn't get his timing right, just a single to deep midwicket
bowls it full and wide, but this is just outside the marker

he could have been out twice there! Bravo moves across to the off side and is lucky to get some pad on it as he misses a straight delivery. He is slow to respond to Dhoni's call for a single then, and could have been run out had Faulkner hit, he was nowhere in the frame
swings across the line this time and finds another couple at deep square leg
he looks to pick that area at extra cover again, but doesn't get the timing this time. The ball lands safely and the batsman picks two
he gets to his half-century with a neat clip to deep midwicket. A superb innings in the context of the game
poor delivery now! Bravo gets a long hop and he hammers it over midwicket for a huge huge hit
another inside out drive, another boundary! He steps out, takes the ball on the full, and punches it beautifully through extra cover
now Dhoni steps out but his struggle with timing continues, can only hit it along the ground to long on
comes down the pitch and punches the fuller delivery to deep midwicket
superb timing from Bravo! He steps out and plays a perfect inside-out drive, all along the ground and beautifully in the gap at wide long off
comes down the pitch and yorks himself, digs it out to the bowler
slower delivery outside off, another dot ball as Dhoni pushes it straight to point
hits it off the middle after quite some time! This was short and outside off, Dhoni gives it his all and whacks it through midwicket for a boundary
comes down the pitch and looks to hammer the length delivery through cover, but hits it straight to the fielder
dabs the length delivery to backward point for a single
he has picked the gap between long on and deep midwicket superbly! It was a full toss but Bravo just placed it perfectly, never looked to hit it too hard
finds a boundary this time! It's a short ball wide outside off and Dhoni steers it through backward point, there is enough pace on it to beat the third man
full and pacy towards the middle stump, the batsman digs it out to long off
gets a half-volley this time and looks to hammer it down the ground, but doesn't get the timing. Just a single to long on
charges down the pitch and looks for the big hit, but it's another dot ball as Dhoni misses it altogether
another dot ball as Dhoni defends the length delivery towards cover
he looks to punch that on the up, though the off side, but mistimes it down to long on for a single
back of length delivery on the stumps, Dhoni pushes it straight to the cover fielder
comes down the pitch but can only dig the slower delivery out to point
lots of width provided this time. Dhoni just reaches out and steers it past the diving point fielder, excellent placement there
picks up the back of length slower delivery but can't get much timing, chips it towards long off
he arches back to create room as he looks to cut this length delivery, but finds point
length delivery outside off, Dhoni pushes it to deep cover to turn the strike over
Bravo keeps finding the middle of the bat! He arches back and lofts this length delivery over extra cover to find a boundary that brings up the 100
he comes down the pitch and was looking to send it out of the stadium, but yet another inside edge to the leg side
fires this one down the leg side, easy call for the umpire
excellent work at the wide long-off boundary by Rahane. This was driven firmly by Bravo and the fielder saved a couple of runs there
this was in the zone! A full toss that should have been smoked over the boundary, but Dhoni gets hurried and punches it back to the bowler, who makes a half-stop
bowls this one with a slight pause, Dhoni punches it straight to cover
pushed through on the stumps, Bravo goes back and works it away to deep midwicket
bowls this from well behind the crease, Dhoni wanted to nudge it to the leg side but gets hit on the pads
stays in the crease and pushes the tossed up delivery to cover
flighted delivery on the stumps, the batsman arches back and drives it to wide long on for a single
tossed up on the stumps, this time he calmly punches it to long off
goes deep in the crease and punches the flighted delivery to deep cover
he charges down the pitch again, but gets an inside edge down to short fine leg
now to the other side! He gets high on his toes to get on top of the bounce, and squeezes it past the point fielder. Beautiful timing again
on the pads and Bravo wristily flicks it past the man at short fine-leg, plenty of timing on that
pounds this on the pitch and it sails over the batsman easily
comes down the pitch again before nudging the length delivery to short fine leg
comes forward but Watson digs it short, Dhoni awkwardly defends it down the pitch
back of length delivery on the leg-stump line, the batsman looks to clip it but gets hit on the pads, takes a leg bye
uses his feet but clips the length delivery calmly to deep square leg for a single
he comes forward and pushes it through cover for a single
he gets his first boundary, courtesy an underedge to the third-man boundary. Dhoni was looking to tap this short delivery towards backward point
stays in the crease this time but cuts it straight to point. Another dot ball
comes down the pitch again and it's another dot ball as he pushes it straight to midwicket
he is looking to get aggressive here.. uses his feet again and flat-bats it firmly, but just straight to mid-off
uses his feet but almost yorks himself with that, plays it towards midwicket
solid defence from Bravo, he punches the length delivery back to the bowler
uses his feet before clipping the length delivery to fine leg
here comes the slower bouncer. It climbs on Bravo but he manages to roll his wrists on it, plays it towards midwicket
gets off the mark with a nudge to the right of cover
he steps out and punches the fuller delivery back down the ground, Faulkner gets a hand to it and parries it to mid-off

he has knocked him over with a length delivery! Smith was looking to hoick it over to the cow-corner boundary but drags it on to his stumps. Royals have got the danger man out. With 11 overs to go, CSK in a spot of bother
another quicker delivery on the pads, this time he clips it to short fine leg for a single
quicker delivery on the pads, the batsman is hurried but gets a useful little inside edge that runs down to the fine-leg boundary
now he gets the ideal length! It's a half-volley on off stump and Smith swings it down the ground for a huge hit
fuller on the stumps, Smith whips it over square leg for a couple of runs to the deep
flatter but on the middle stump line, the batsman nudges it through midwicket and calls back for  a second
fuller delivery on the stumps, the batsman drives it down to long-off
full and on the pads, the batsman digs it out towards wide long-on and comes back for a second
he comes forward and punches the length delivery down to long off
this time he succeeds in hitting it over mid-on. It is off a shorter delivery though. There was plenty of time for him to rock back and find the spot
swipes against the turn and picks up a single to deep midwicket
this was close too! Flighted delivery on the stumps, Bravo looks to chip it over mid-on but toe-ends it to the fielder, just drops short of Karun Nair at mid-on
lots of flight on this one, the batsman digs it out to cover
fuller and on the pads, the batsman looks to flick but gets hit on the pads
he throws his bat at this wider delivery and it's not too far from the cover fielder, just out of the reach
he comes forward and pushes it back to the bowler
nicely slows it down on off stump, the batsman comes forward and defends

another one goes down! Superb catch by Morris at long-off. Faf looked to attack the flighted delivery and almost beats the fielder. But Morris, who is a bit inside the boundary, has to leap up to grab that one. He falls backwards but he is safely inside the boundary
he looks to paddle this, but Ankit pushes it well wide of the off stump. Faf carries on with his shot and ramps it on to his helmet
back of length on off, the batsman defends it to mid-on
length delivery on the stumps, Smith punches it to the off side but can't beat point
he gets off the mark with a punch through midwicket. Faf shuffles across to the off side and just pushes it in the gap

that's the end of Raina, the extra bounce does it. Morris slants it across Raina at good pace and the batsman looks to steer it to third man. But this is too close and he feathers an edge to the keeper
length delivery on the stumps, Raina goes for an ugly cross-batted swipe and drags it through square leg. There is not much timing there, but the batsman get a boundary
back of length delivery on off, Raina hops on the crease and defends it to off
bowls a fuller one this time, the batsman punches it past the non-striker, past the diving mid-off
here comes the slower delivery, the batsman mistimes his flat-batted shot to mid-off
stays in the crease and punches the back of length delivery to midwicket
he has got hold of this one, short ball and this has been smeared over fine leg. Smith swivels and gives it good thwack
he comes forward and defends the length delivery to mid-off
back of length delivery on the stumps, Smith looks to pull but gets a bottom edge to short fine leg
comes down the pitch but the bowler pulls the length back, punches it down to mid-on
keeps bowling down the leg side, Smith looks to paddle it fine but doesn't get hold of it, takes a single to backward square leg
full and flighted on the stumps, Raina comes forward and pushes it to long off
tossed up on the pads, Smith nudges it to deep midwicket for a single
this one is down the leg side too, it would have been a wide but Smith paddles it easily to pick up the second boundary
loose delivery to start, he bowls it short and on the pads from round the wicket, Smith whacks it over square leg with ease
flighted and full, there is no space to get under it and all Raina can do is punch it back at the bowler
he goes back and across and punches the top-spinner back to the bowler
waits on the back foot and punches the flatter delivery to long on for a single
uses his feet and takes the flighted delivery on the full, flicks it to deep midwicket to get off the mark

he missed him first ball, but he has the man on the second! McCullum looks to pull this flatter delivery over midwicket but gets hurried by the ball, doesn't get it off the middle and lobs an easy chance to mid-on
that is hammered back to the bower. It was also a chance to catch, but that was flying quickly and straight down the ground
takes a step down the pitch and looks to hammer this over mid-on, but Morris slows it down a touch. It beats the inside edge and fortunately for Smith, misses the stumps

this is not short enough, but Smith feasts on such back of length deliveries.. He swivels on his back leg and pulls it down to long leg. Binny slides and makes the save, just in time to keep the batsman to two
he waits in the crease and steers the length delivery straight to point
he looks to whip it over the midwicket fielder, but the ball moves in just enough to beat the bat, hits Smith on the groin
gets good bounce from a length. Smith stays in the crease and defends it to the leg side
starts off with a tight back of length delivery on the stumps, Smith defends it to midwicket
he comes forward and defends the tossed up delivery back down the pitch
another poor delivery. Ankit offers width outside off and McCullum is not going to miss out on those.. he waits on the back foot and slaps it in the gap at cover
flatter and on the leg stump line, McCullum goes back and across and defends it down the pitch

poor delivery, he floats it up but this is heading down the leg side, McCullum doesn't need to do much, he flicks it and picks the gap at backward square leg. Hooda slides near the boundary but can't keep it in
tossed up on the middle and leg line, McCullum defends it calmly
pushed through on the middle stumps, Smith gets off the mark with a neat push to long on
another slower delivery and Karun whips it to square leg to complete a comprehensive win
No he will not! This is a slower ball and what does Smith do? he chips it straight back at the bowler. Will it be Faulkner then?
short delivery this time and Smith slaps it straight to short fine leg for a single.
fuller on the off, Smith eases it down to long-off. The throw comes in from the deep, hits the stumps and ricochets away, allowing an extra run
length delivery outside off, Rahane gets hurried as this is the quicker one, dragged down to long on
slower bouncer this time, Rahane has seen that coming and he ramps it from the right of Dhoni was a couple to third man
fires a good, fast yorker that Rahane digs out to cover.. Raina picks it up and aims at the non-stirker's but misses and gives away an overthrow
length delivery outside off and Smith hammers it to the leg side, a diving save at midwicket from the fielding Smith prevents a certain boundary
pushed through on the stumps, the batsman defends it down the pitch
steps out of the crease and punches the length ball down to long off
he comes forward to play a defensive shot towards backward point but Smith wants a single and completes it easily
he waits on the back foot and punches the length delivery through cover
drives the fuller delivery but can't find the gap at cover
here's a wicket against the run of play! Jadeja fires in a yorker that squeezes under the bat and knocks the stumps down. Well done David
another slower ball, Watson waits for it before steering it through backward point for a single
short and slower, the batsman has to adjust for the lack of pace as he pulls it through square leg
fires it in the blockhole but Rahane picks up an easy couple to wide long on
fuller and quicker outside off, Rahane looks to drive it but misses

oh what luck! Watson gets a big leading edge as he looks to blast this slower delivery down the ground. He gives it up as soon as he hits it.. but there is no one at square leg. Dwayne Smith runs towards it from short fine leg but never gets there. Dwayne Bravo from the deep never runs in. It lands safely
starts off with a slower ball but that is calmly pushed towards long on for a single
makes room and swings across the line of this length delivery but gets an inside edge that rolls towards deep backward square leg
he tucks the length delivery through midwicket to bring up the record opening partnership for Royals, beating a six-year old record
he is beaten a touch by the lack of pace on this delivery and ends up slicing it towards point
creates room and thrashes the length delivery to deep cover, just for a single this time
bowls a low full toss and Watson takes full toll, powers it through mid-off for a boundary. There is no one in the deep to cut it off
loud appeal from Dhoni for a caught behind as Watson misses the pull shot, but the umpire calls it a wide as it's way down the leg side. It would have been a wide to a left-hander
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman punches it down to long on for a single
he picks up the slower one early and pushes it towards midwicket for an easy single
misses out on a low full toss as he gets an inside edge on to his pads
fuller delivery on the stumps, the batsman punches it down the ground to long on
length delivery on off, he punches it straight to cover
another poor delivery, this is short and Rahane pulls it expertly in the gap at backward square leg
uff! That is a whole lot of timing and a bit of power too.. Rahane looks to launch this length delivery and gets it off the middle.. whacks it over the cow corner
a dot ball for CSK as Watson pushes this straight back at the bowler
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it to cover for a quick single
and another outside edge! This time the third-man is back at the boundary and it lands well short of him
back of length on the leg-stump line, Rahane pulls it down to fine leg for a single
back of length delivery on off, punched to cover
length delivery on the pads, easily flicked to deep backward square leg for a couple that brings up Rahane's fifty now.. Excellent from both Royals openers
he is beaten by this slower ball but picks up yet another boundary as the outside edge lobs over the short third-man fielder. Bravo is not impressed but Watson is collecting all sorts of runs here
fuller outside off, the batsman looks to squeeze it through off but doesn't connect
he keeps piling them on! This time he picks up a four off a thick outside edge that lands safely behind short third man

take that! He gets his front leg out of the way and hammers this length delivery flat and long over wide long-on. That 's his fifty in his debut game.. What a change from his struggles during the World Cup
length delivery, he comes forward and whips it through midwicket for a single
he makes room and chops the length delivery through point for a single to the deep
looks to hit firmly down the ground but doesn't get the power behind it, picks up a single to long on through
waits in the crease and eases this to deep cover for a single
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman flat-bats it down the ground to long-on. Both batsmen on 46 off 32 now
waits on the back foot and dabs it towards short third man for a quick single
gives Watson the space to free his arms and the batsman slaps it firmly to deep cover
he keeps the strike rotating with a push to midwicket
gets the same delivery, but this time he punches it through cover point for a single to the deep
turns, but this is short again, Rahane goes deep in the crease and punches it to deep extra cover for another couple
moves to the leg side to create room and punches it to deep cover

this is flat, this is long! Watson was going for the slog sweep no matter what the delivery.. he had to reach out a little as it was delivered slower but he manages to drag it over the boundary at midwicket
straighter this time, Rahane tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single
pushes this well wide outside off and it's short as well! Rahane has all the time to do whatever he wants to do with this, he slaps it behind point to pick up a boundary
more aggression against Jadeja as Watson again looks to hit him over the top on off side, gets another thick outside edge through point
meanwhile, Rahane takes the calm approach, punches it with soft hands towards long on
looks to power the length ball down the ground but gets a thick outside edge, it lands behind point and they run for a single
quicker delivery on the pads, the batsman defends it to the leg side
make it two in two! This is even bigger.. He comes closer to the pitch of the delivery and hammers it over long-off
he takes a small step forward and launches into the bowler, smacks him straight down the ground for his first six, just clears the rope
punches it back down the pitch and Ashwin is not able to stop it cleanly, parries it to mid-off
goes deep in the crease and punches the length delivery down to long on
turn or no turn, Watson was going for the big heave.. he hits is straight to Bravo at deep midwicket for a single
he waits on the crease and whips the length delivery to deep midwicket for a single
quicker delivery on off, Watson waits on the back foot and punches it to deep cover
lots of spin now for Ashwin, it jags back from wide of off, Rahane waits on the back foot and chops it to backward point for a single
gets some away turn on this, but it's short enough for Rahane to adjust and work it away to long on
quicker delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it off the back foot
pushed through on the stumps, Rahane comes forward and tickles it to fine leg
uses his reach to come forward and slash the fuller delivery to deep cover
goes back to give him some room but cuts it straight to backward point
starts off with a flighted delivery on off, Watson pushes it to cover
stands tall and punches the length ball to mid-off for a quick single
bowls this one short and Watson was waiting for that error, he slaps it through square leg for a boundary. That actually stopped a bit on him too
looks to carve this length ball through off but finds the fielder again, straight to cover
strays on the pads and Watson times it beautifully but Bravo does well to intercept it at midwicket. A meter here or there and that was four
he leans forward and drives commandingly the length ball but hits it straight to mid-off
length delivery on the stumps, pushed to mid-off

he comes forward and pushes it beautifully with a lot of timing through midwicket. Bravo chases and could have stopped it but gets into a tangle as he tries to stop it with his feet. It rolls over to the boundary
another one that was too close! Watson gets a leading edge and it just lobs over Nehra.. he jumps but cannot grab at that.. it was within his reach
punches this on the up but almost hits it straight to Faf at mid-off! It just lands short of the fielder
he stays back and punches the length delivery back at the bowler
pushes this to mid-off with soft hands and calls for a quick single

he has mistimed this towards mid-on but it just evades Bravo and runs quickly to the boundary. Bravo chases it but cannot keep it in.He was looking to play that to the leg side but closed the bat face too early
this time he plays the shot he wanted to off the previous ball and gets it on the middle, punches this length ball through cover for a couple
thick outside edge but there is no one at slip! It runs down to the boundary rapidly. Watson was looking to drive it on the up
he stays in the crease and pushes the length delivery to mid-off with soft hands to pick up a quick single
he stands tall and punches the back of length delivery to the off
more timing! This is back of length outside off, waist high and Rahane swings it across the line to pick up a six over midwicket. That was superbly timed. No flourish in that shot
starts off with a length delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it back down the pitch
tight line around off, the batsman pushes it straight to cover point
on the stumps, Rahane waits in the crease and clips it to fine leg
back of length on off, the batsman cuts it down to third man
high elbow, superb forward stride, timing and panache! This shot had everything. It was on a length and Watson punches it superbly through cover
on the pads, he waits and clips it to deep square leg for a single
he picks up another boundary with superb timing! Just punches the fuller delivery in the air, over Shane Watson's head.. the timing does the rest
slightly fuller and wider outside off, Watson drives it straight to cover
back of length around off, swivelled towards midwicket again for one
goes down on a knee to drive the full ball outside off, inside edge just misses the stumps and goes to leg behind square
touch back of length around off, turned to leg side for a quick single
this time he connects and caresses it for four. Nehra got this closer to the batsman, it was fuller too and Rahane punched it down the ground with a firm drive to beat mid off
nearly gets the outside edge by bowling this one across from outside off, Rahane chased it with a drive away from the body and missed
short of length on off stump, Watson defends it back
towards off and middle now from back of length, Rahane gets off the mark by tucking it to leg with another bottom edge
back of length and closer to off, pushed down to mid-off off the back foot
gets a bottom edge while trying to cut the wider delivery outside off, stopped by cover point
shapes it away slightly from outside off, Rahane defends off the front foot
length delivery outside off, Rahane moves forward and defends it into the covers
